headline: BGB and locals block BSF 'push-in' attempt in Lalmonirhat
summary: Border Guard Bangladesh and local residents resisted efforts by the Indian Border Security Force to push people through a barbed-wire gate into Bangladesh.
details: The Border Guard Bangladesh (BGB) has blocked another attempt by the Indian Border Security Force (BSF) to "push-in" people through the border of Lalmonirhat’s Patgram Upazila.

Lt Col Syed Fazle Munim, commander of the 61st BGB Battalion, confirmed that the BSF tried to push men, women, and children through a barbed-wire gate at the Tepurgari border around 1:30 am on Friday.
Local residents noticed the activity and immediately alerted the BGB's Kalirhat camp patrol team.
BGB members and locals worked together to resist the push-in attempt, preventing the infiltration.
The BGB has since intensified surveillance along the border to prevent further attempts.
This incident is one of several similar "push-in" attempts by the BSF that have been thwarted by the BGB earlier this month.

headline_marked: Injury blow: [[Pulisic out of USA's second World Cup match]]
headline: Injury blow: Pulisic out of USA's second World Cup match
summary: Star forward Christian Pulisic will miss the clash against Australia due to a calf injury suffered during the opening game.
details: USA star forward Christian Pulisic will miss the team's second World Cup group match against Australia this Friday.
Head coach Mauricio Pochettino confirmed the news, stating that the player has not yet fully recovered from a calf injury.
Pulisic was substituted at half-time during the USA's 4-1 victory over Paraguay a week ago.
Despite the setback, Pochettino noted that Pulisic's recovery is progressing well and he was training yesterday.
The coach expressed hope that the player would be ready for selection again as soon as possible.
Both the USA and Australia are fighting for a spot in the knockout rounds, with a victory in their Group D game in Seattle potentially securing qualification.
caption:
A major blow for the USMNT! Christian Pulisic is sidelined for the critical clash against Australia.

USA star forward Christian Pulisic will miss the team's second World Cup group match against Australia this Friday.

Head coach Mauricio Pochettino confirmed the news, stating that the player has not yet fully recovered from a calf injury.

Pulisic was substituted at half-time during the USA's 4-1 victory over Paraguay a week ago.

Despite the setback, Pochettino noted that Pulisic's recovery is progressing well and he was training yesterday.

The coach expressed hope that the player would be ready for selection again as soon as possible.

Both the USA and Australia are fighting for a spot in the knockout rounds, with a victory in their Group D game in Seattle potentially securing qualification.
